author: blu
body: Genetic algorithm conductor. Integer-encoded chromosomes with tournament selection, single-point crossover, and mutation. Fitness is caller-supplied as a List Integer (one per individual). The GA manages population evolution; the caller evaluates fitness.

author: blu
body: These functions are that loop, generic over the individual. The domain supplies breed and mutate; the core supplies ranking, elitism and the offspring walk. The integer-vector API above becomes one instantiation of it (see the adapter below) rather than the only shape on offer.

author: blu
body: The selection strategy here is rank-with-elitism, lifted from the version in apps/games/magic that has actually run against a fitness landscape. ga-evolve keeps its own tournament-with-full-replacement and is unchanged; the two are different strategies and both are legitimate.

author: blu
body: The offspring walk pairs each parent with its neighbour, wrapping, so a pool of one still breeds. breed sees two parents and a seed; mutate sees the child and a seed. Neither is given the config, because a config is domain data: a caller that needs one binds it in a named wrapper, as the adapter below does.

author: blu
body: The chapter's own representation, expressed as one instantiation of the core rather than as the only thing it can do. These two wrappers are what a domain has to supply, and they are three lines each.
